Further Testing on Twitter: https://x.com/Dubibubiii

Screw the benchmarks, everyone wants to know which model is actually the best. In this video, I dive deep into a head-to-head comparison of GPT-Astra 6 and Claude Fable 5.1, putting them through rigorous tests to determine which one truly reigns supreme. I’ve spent hours designing four different tests that will push these models to their absolute limits. From output quality to cost and speed, I’m here to uncover the truth. I woke up at 6 am just for this announcement, and trust me, you don’t want to miss the results!
